newsitem.title: USA: Oklahoma narrows bond adviser candidates to three.
newsitem.headline: Oklahoma narrows bond adviser candidates to three.

text.p: Oklahoma has narrowed its bond adviser search to three candidates, and could select a successor for outgoing State Bond Advisor James Joseph as early as May 15, Joseph said Tuesday.

"They have three finalists they would like to interview for a second time at a full bond oversight commission meeting," Joseph said. "We have scheduled one for the 15th of this month, and at that time they could make a decision."
The meeting would be a joint one between the state's Executive Bond Oversight Commission and its Legislative Bond Oversight Commission.

Joseph in January announced that he would leave the post he has held since September 1991 to become a partner at Government Finance Group Inc, an Arlington, Va., financial advisory firm. He has been dividing his time between the two posts since April 1, he said earlier.
Joseph Tuesday said he would continue to assist Oklahoma until a replacement can be found or until June 30, the end of the state's fiscal year, whichever comes first.
